messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: high queue growth on dedicated pool "resv-eu-7"; capacity>98%; potential customer impact. Severity: Sev2.

 eva-oncall: Acknowledged — jumping in. Which customers are seeing errors vs latency?

 chen-infra: Metrics: queued_requests +360% over 20m, pool_util 99.2%. Autoscaler attempted scale_up to 36 -> denied: cloud_quota_limit. Controller logs show rate_limit and quota errors.

 chen-infra: log:
```
2026-04-02T14:02:12Z controller: attempt_scale_up pool=resv-eu-7 desired=36 current=34 result=quota_limit project=redwood-eu-2
2026-04-02T14:02:13Z queue: queued=412 waiting_for_gpu
```

 sam-runtime: Correlating sessions: high number of long-running streams from tenant:atlasdata (batch embedding jobs) and tenant:medscope (interactive analyses). They hold KV cache and prevent rebalancing.

 alex-sre: Immediate plan: (1) evict idle >5m best-effort sessions for atlasdata and medscope, (2) lower concurrency for background jobs, (3) enable short-term routing of non-SLA endpoints to hosted cluster. Can someone run evict commands?

 eva-oncall: Run it, please. Keep 1 reserved slot per enterprise.

 alex-sre: Running:
```
redctl evict --pool resv-eu-7 --tenant atlasdata --idle-gt 300 --min-reserved 1 --confirm
redctl evict --pool resv-eu-7 --tenant medscope --idle-gt 300 --min-reserved 1 --confirm
redctl quota update --pool resv-eu-7 --class best-effort --rate 8rps
```

 maria-cs: Notifying CSMs now. Draft: "We're mitigating a transient capacity shortage in a dedicated GPU pool; you may see slower processing for non-critical jobs. Working on targeted mitigations; ETA 30m." Any additional customer notes?

 eva-oncall: Add that we're enabling hosted fallback for non-SLA inference and that we've limited background throughput.

 chen-infra: Evictions done. queued dropped 412 -> 134 in 7m. Autoscaler still blocked: project-level GPU quota at 36 (hard limit). I filed cloud ticket CLOUD-EU-1982; provider responded with tentative +4 GPUs in ~15m.

 sam-runtime: While we wait, I disabled session pinning for long-running batch importers (feature-flag rollback) to allow normal eviction. That reclaimed roughly 3 GPUs worth of mem.

 alex-sre: We also discovered an autoscaler config: max_replicas per-pool was 40 but our project quota was 36 — mismatch allowed controller to attempt impossible scales. Need to surface mismatch.

 eva-oncall: Good catch. Update runbook: validate desired_max_replicas <= cloud_project_quota. For now, can we temporarily migrate some low-traffic enterprise reservations to resv-eu-spare? Any objections to a 2-GPU attach?

 chen-infra: resv-eu-spare has 3 free GPUs. I'll attach 2 to resv-eu-7 for immediate relief. Doing infra attach now; ETA ~10m.

 maria-cs: Two customers (atlasdata, medscope) replied: atlasdata reports batch job failures marked as "resource error"; medscope reports slowed interactive sessions. Escalating to CSEs.

 alex-sre: Attach complete. Queue dropped to 29. High-priority SLA traffic green. Recommend keeping post-incident actions: (1) alert on scale_up failures due to quota with project id, (2) add validation test between autoscaler max and cloud quota, (3) create reserve buffer pool per region.

 eva-oncall: Closing pager but staying on for handoff. Creating Sev2 ticket and assigning postmortem to alex-sre and sam-runtime. Documenting customer impact in ticket.

 incident-bot: Pager closed by eva-oncall at 1756012300. Postmortem required.
